name: 93108 · Santa Barbara, CA
findings: ZIP 93108 (Santa Barbara) has 136 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 32 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 93108 (Santa Barbara) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 93108 (Santa Barbara) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 32 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.
